mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, created_at, updatetime, email, phone, birthday, status, is_deleted FROM `user` WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `user` (username, password, created_at, updatetime, email, phone, birthday, status, is_deleted) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{createdAt}, #{updatetime}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{birthday}, #{status}, #{isDeleted})
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, created_at, updatetime, email, phone, birthday, status, is_deleted FROM `user` WHERE username = #{username} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, username, password, created_at, updatetime, email, phone, birthday, status, is_deleted FROM `user` WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE `user` SET username = #{username}, status = #{status}, updatetime = #{updatetime}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, birthday = #{birthday} WHERE id = #{id}
